mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_dividends (symbol, ex_date, dividend_type, amount_per_share, record_date, payable_date, process_date, is_special, is_foreign, cusip, vendor_id, source, synced_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{exDate}, #{dividendType}, #{amountPerShare}, #{recordDate}, #{payableDate}, #{processDate}, #{special}, #{foreign}, #{cusip}, #{vendorId}, 'ALPACA', NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount_per_share = VALUES(amount_per_share), record_date = VALUES(record_date), payable_date = VALUES(payable_date), process_date = VALUES(process_date), is_special = VALUES(is_special), is_foreign = VALUES(is_foreign), cusip = VALUES(cusip), vendor_id = VALUES(vendor_id), synced_at = NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, ex_date, dividend_type, amount_per_share, record_date, payable_date, process_date, is_special AS special, is_foreign AS `foreign`, cusip, vendor_id FROM stock_dividends WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY ex_date DESC

SELECT symbol, ex_date, dividend_type, amount_per_share, record_date, payable_date, process_date, is_special AS special, is_foreign AS `foreign`, cusip, vendor_id FROM stock_dividends WHERE ex_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY symbol, ex_date

SELECT user_id, portfolio_id, SUM(CASE side WHEN 'BUY' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END) AS quantity FROM transactions WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND trade_date < #{exDate} AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY user_id, portfolio_id HAVING quantity > 0
SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM holdings WHERE quantity > 0
